_comment: sakura-petals-everywhere config. Edit this file, then run apply.ps1 (it reverts to the prior state and re-patches automatically). apply.ps1 CLI flags (-All / -Hometown / -Castle) override what's here.
_notes: hometown/castle turn the sakura petal material on for that world. Only the leaf LOOK changes; leaf counts, scatter positions and bounds stay per-world. The sakura map is always petals, so it has no flag.
